objective: Convert attention from a commentary/source Reel into an attributed Action Network account and mission join.

source_usage.note: Record the source Reel URL for attribution and editorial review. Do not automatically download or republish third-party footage.

voiceover.text: Take the streets back from racism.
Join the social network built around action, not likes.
Don't just watch it. Do something.

onboarding_demo.action: Create or sign into the account.

overlays: DON'T JUST WATCH IT. DO SOMETHING.
caption: Tired of racism? Stop arguing in the comments. Take the streets back from racism. Join the Action Network: pick an action, join a mission, and show what you did. Don't just watch it. Do something.
